title: joule operator SOP
purpose: Day-to-day operation of a joule distributed cluster lab and future public pool gateway/dashboard.
scope: Operators running joule coordinators, donor agents, capacity dashboard, and release gates for f00-sh/joule.

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.body: This SOP defines how operators run joule safely: cluster lab checks, live capacity visibility, contribution gates, and release documentation. Graphical flowcharts are mandatory for gate and ship flows.

sections.heading: Day-to-day gates
sections.body: Before exposing any gateway: (1) cargo test green, (2) joule lab succeeds, (3) joule capacity --json succeeds, (4) ledger mint/burn demo succeeds, (5) dashboard or capacity API reflects healthy nodes when cluster is live, (6) no freeloader path without contribution checks when API is enabled.

sections.heading: Release ship flow
sections.body: Ship only via house release workflow: tests green, CHANGELOG, file_id.diz, README/Pages/man sync, SOP PDF, release memo PDF, tag, attach assets.
